errors.evidence: The Spanish/Portuguese word 'altura' (height) is used in a Chinese sentence, which is grammatically incorrect and impairs readability.

errors.text_span: 对于 Test1，柱状图 altura大约是 33.3%（无）、28.3%（i-向量）、24.3%（d-向量）和 28.3%（s-向量）。
errors.evidence: The numerical values reported for Test1 are all significantly incorrect. The machine reports approximately 33.3%, 28.3%, 24.3%, and 28.3%, whereas the actual values shown in the chart are approximately 38.5%, 33%, 30%, and 30% respectively.

Multiple values reported for Test5 are incorrect. For '无' (None), the value is ~31%, not 33.3%. For 'i-向量' (i-vector), the value is ~26%, not 24.3%. For 's-向量' (s-vector), the value is ~24%, not 28.3%. These are significant inaccuracies.

errors.text_span: 但没有明显的整体趋势
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there is no obvious overall trend. There are two clear trends visible: 1) For all methods, the WER generally decreases from Test1 to Test5. 2) Within each test set, the '无' (None) method has the highest WER, while the other methods show improvements.

The description only provides numerical data for the first (Test1) and last (Test5) categories, completely omitting the data for Test2, Test3, and Test4. This omission of 60% of the data groups contributes to the incorrect conclusion that there is no overall trend.
